Lithic (https://lithic.com) | Senior Software Engineer ; Engineering Manager | REMOTE

Lithic is the modern API for issuing & processing payment cards across Visa, Mastercard, and Amex. We're a small engineering team building the infrastructure layer powering billions in transactions for fintechs, startups, and enterprises. If you want to work on hard problems in real-time financial systems at scale then come build the future of payments with us.

A few open roles:

- Engineering Manager ($169-265k) — Apply here: https://grnh.se/m0egl9zi4us

- Senior Software Engineer, Treasury ($160-200k) - Apply here: https://grnh.se/ubprc3e24us

- Senior Software Engineer, Issuing ($160-200k) - Apply here: https://grnh.se/ncbb3vl54us

Those application links will fast track directly to me (Jason, co-founder/CTO). Also feel free to reach out to me directly via email at jason@.

Also... We're hiring for many more roles too- check them out here: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/lithic
